Elevation analysis

This analysis have been performed making groups each elevation level and see the trends.

getwd()
## [1] "C:/Users/selene.baez/Downloads/ANDREA PENDING/NUMEX_pre_RStudio"
data_for_R <- read_excel('data_for_R.xlsx')
## New names:
## • `` -> `...1`
data = data_for_R

data$Con <- ifelse(data$Sub == "C", 1, 0)
data$N <- ifelse(data$Sub %in% c("N", "NP"), 1, 0)
data$P <- ifelse(data$Sub %in% c("P", "NP"), 1, 0)

ggplot(data, aes(x = `δ18O in ‰ vs DeltaSMOW`, 
                 y = `δ13C (‰ v.s.V-PDB)`,colour = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ elevation_m, ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = expression(delta^{18}*O),
    y = expression(delta^{13}*C),
    title = "Relationship between δ13C and δ18O per species"
  )
## Warning: Removed 2 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

# Then here we split the data per elevation group and apply models to see the differences between species and treatments.
# Same analysis with each response variable.

datos_3000 <- data %>%
filter(data$Site == "CaNu")

datos_3000 <- datos_3000%>%
  mutate(
    Bloque = case_when(
      Plot %in% 1:4   ~ 1,
      Plot %in% 5:8   ~ 2,
      Plot %in% 9:12  ~ 3,
      Plot %in% 13:16 ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
modelCaNu_iWUE <- lmer(`iWUE (μmol/mol)` ~ N+P+N*P + (1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_3000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
modelCaNu_18O <- lmer(`δ18O in ‰ vs DeltaSMOW` ~ N+P+N*P + (1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_3000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
modelCaNu_15N <- lmer(`δ15N (‰ v.s.AIR)` ~ N+P+N*P + (1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_3000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
modelCaNu_CN <- lmer(`C:N` ~ N+P+N*P + (1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_3000)


datos_1000 <- data %>%
filter(data$Site == "BoN")

datos_1000 <- datos_1000 %>%
  mutate(
    Bloque = case_when(
      Plot %in% 1:4   ~ 1,
      Plot %in% 5:8   ~ 2,
      Plot %in% 9:12  ~ 3,
      Plot %in% 13:16 ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
modelBoNu_iWUE <- lmer(`iWUE (μmol/mol)` ~ N+P+N*P +(1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_1000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
modelBoNu_18O <- lmer(`δ18O in ‰ vs DeltaSMOW` ~ N+P+N*P +(1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_1000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
modelBoNu_15N <- lmer(`δ15N (‰ v.s.AIR)` ~ N+P+N*P +(1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_1000)
## Warning in checkConv(attr(opt, "derivs"), opt$par, ctrl = control$checkConv, :
## Model failed to converge with max|grad| = 0.00312257 (tol = 0.002, component 1)
modelBoNu_CN <- lmer(`C:N` ~ N+P+N*P +(1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_1000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
datos_2000 <- data %>%
filter(data$Site == "SFNu")

datos_2000<- datos_2000 %>%
  mutate(
    Bloque = case_when(
      Plot %in% 1:4   ~ 1,
      Plot %in% 6:9   ~ 2,
      Plot %in% 11:14  ~ 3,
      Plot %in% 16:19 ~ 4,

    )
  )


modelSF_iWUE <- lmer(`iWUE (μmol/mol)` ~ N+P+N*P + (1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_2000)
modelSF_18O <- lmer(`δ18O in ‰ vs DeltaSMOW` ~ N+P+N*P + (1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_2000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
modelSF_15N <- lmer(`δ15N (‰ v.s.AIR)` ~ N+P+N*P + (1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_2000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
modelSF_CN <- lmer(`C:N` ~ N+P+N*P + (1 |name) + (1 |Bloque/Plot), data = datos_2000)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
### Results For BoNu for iWUE, there is a marginal effect of N and N:P but not significant. SF no effect.CaNu no effect.
models  <- list(
  "3000 m - iWUE (μmol/mol)" = modelCaNu_iWUE,
  "3000 m - O18"  = modelCaNu_18O,
  "3000 m - N15"  = modelCaNu_15N,
  "3000 m - CN"   = modelCaNu_CN,

  "2000 m iWUE" = modelSF_iWUE,
  "2000 m O18"  = modelSF_18O,
  "2000 m N15"  = modelSF_15N,
  "2000 m CN"   = modelSF_CN,

  "1000 m iWUE" = modelBoNu_iWUE,
  "1000 m O18"  = modelBoNu_18O,
  "1000 m N15"  = modelBoNu_15N,
  "1000 m CN"   = modelBoNu_CN)

 
# exportar tabla
tab <- modelsummary(
  models,
  output = "data.frame",
  stars = TRUE,
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "aic")
)

# transponer
tab_t <- as.data.frame(t(tab))

# fijar nombres de columna usando la primera fila
colnames(tab_t) <- tab_t[1, ]
tab_t <- tab_t[-1, ]  # quitar fila original de nombres

# mostrar tabla
kable(tab_t)

### Results For BoNu for iWUE, there is a marginal effect of N and N:P but not significant. SF no effect.CaNu no effect.
plot_diagnostics <- function(model, model_name) {
  
  res <- residuals(model)#residual
  fit <- fitted(model) #model
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2)) #graph
  
  # Residuals vs Fitted
  plot(fit, res,
       xlab = "Fitted values",
       ylab = "Residuals",
       main = paste(model_name, "\nResiduals vs Fitted"))
  abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
  
  # QQ plot
  qqnorm(res, main = paste(model_name, "\nNormal Q-Q"))
  qqline(res, col = "red", lty = 2)
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

#apply the plot_diagnostics_to_all
pdf("model_diagnostics_elevatiom.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)

for (nm in names(models)) {
  plot_diagnostics(models[[nm]], nm)
}

dev.off()

# Run and plot
for (nm in names(models)) {
  cat("\n", nm, "\n")
  res <- simulateResiduals(models[[nm]], n = 1000)
  plot(res, main = nm)
}

testUniformity(res)

## 
##  Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
## D = 0.28117, p-value = 0.001012
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided
testDispersion(res)

## 
##  DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs.
##  simulated
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## dispersion = 1.1055, p-value = 0.56
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
testOutliers(res)

## 
##  DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate
##  expectations
## 
## data:  res
## outliers at both margin(s) = 0, observations = 48, p-value = 1
## alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.001998002
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.00000000 0.07397279
## sample estimates:
## frequency of outliers (expected: 0.001998001998002 ) 
##                                                    0
pdf("DHARMa_diagnostics_elevation.pdf", width = 9, height = 7)

for (nm in names(models)) {
  res <- simulateResiduals(models[[nm]], n = 1000)
  plot(res, main = nm)
}

dev.off()
